assertions.assertion: The member presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope
The symptoms are poorly correlated with standard short-term monitoring
There is concern for intermittent bradyarrhythmias associated with sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis code I49.5 is associated with sick sinus syndrome
There is a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmia
There is a need to capture infrequent symptomatic events over an extended period
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated
The study is intended to establish a definitive diagnosis and guide further management
The indication is documented in the clinical indication note
The appeal addresses the denial under Reason Code PR-204
CPT 93247 was not covered under the member's current benefit plan
